summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for P1.C P2P Flow Completion (Create GR from PO). All 23 test cases passed (100% success rate). Verified: GET /remaining endpoint (404/draft/approved scenarios), POST /create-gr endpoint (draft→400, approved→200, fully_received→400), GET /grs audit trail, over-receive validation (400 with error), end-to-end P2P flow (PO creation → approval → GR creation → partial receive → second GR → full receive), status transitions (approved→partially_received→fully_received), and stock sync to rahaza_material_stock. POC script also passed all 13 user stories.
